t: This Fortress Trade 2" Angled Sash Paint Brush is engineered for precision painting and effective cutting-in around fixtures and detailed areas. Ideal for professional decorators on interior and exterior projects, its synthetic bristles and angled head offer superior control. Solid, round tapered filaments provide superb paint load capability, suitable for all paint types including emulsion and gloss. Mixed filaments minimise tramlines for a flawless finish. Featuring a rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule and a comfortable beavertail handle, this durable brush ensures ergonomic use and quick, easy cleaning, making it a reliable tool for any demanding painting job.
